tools.name: search
tools.description:
Find buildings, developers, districts and cities of Cyprus on ailiste by name, in any language
(English, Greek, Russian, Ukrainian, Hebrew, Chinese); a typo is forgiven. At most 8 matches, best
first, each with its ailiste page. `lang` is the language of the names and links given back.

tools.name: find_buildings
tools.description:
List new-build projects in Cyprus that match every filter given, 10 at a time (pass `offset` to go
on). `city`, `district` and `developer` take a name in any language or an ailiste id; a
district includes its quarters. `bedrooms` keeps buildings that have homes of that size (0 = studio).
`stage`: pl

tools.name: get_building
tools.description:
Everything ailiste's page says about one building, by its ailiste id or its page's address: the
developer and its site, the stage and the day we saw it, our photographs, delivery, floors, homes,
bedrooms, sizes, the asking price it starts at, views, amenities - and how many adverts there are for
it;

tools.name: district_prices
tools.description:
Asking prices in one district or city of Cyprus for one kind of home: per square metre and for the
whole home - the median, the mean and the middle half - with the number of homes they stand on, the
day, and the city's median beside a district's. `bedrooms` 0 to 4 for apartments, 2 to 5 for houses.

tools.name: get_developer
tools.description:
A developer of new builds in Cyprus, by its name or its ailiste id: its own site, how many
buildings it has on ailiste - by city, by stage, by kind - how many our team has stood at, and the
first of them.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_building" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
